translations.web: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
translations.bsb: And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they turned to blood.
translations.kjv: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
translations.asv: And the third poured out his bowl into the rivers and the fountains of the waters; and it became blood.
